name: Nova Buds Pro
shortDescription: True wireless earbuds with 40 h battery and active noise cancellation.
description: Nova Buds Pro deliver studio-grade sound in a featherlight form factor. Active noise cancellation (ANC) lets you focus anywhere, while Transparency mode keeps you aware of your surroundings. Six microphones ensure crystal-clear calls. IPX5 sweat resistance makes them perfect for workouts or commutes. Each bud lasts 10 h; the compact charging case adds 30 h more.

name: Zenith Smartwatch X2
shortDescription: AMOLED smartwatch with health tracking, GPS, and 7-day battery.
description: Track your health round the clock with Zenith X2. The vivid 1.43" AMOLED display stays visible even in bright sunlight. Built-in GPS, SpO2 sensor, and 24/7 heart-rate monitoring give you actionable health insights. Over 100 sport modes and water resistance to 5 ATM make it a true all-weather companion. Pairs with both Android and iOS.

name: Swift USB-C Hub 7-in-1
shortDescription: Expand any laptop with HDMI 4K, 3× USB-A, SD card, and 100W PD.
description: One compact hub replaces the entire cable clutter on your desk. The Swift 7-in-1 supports 4K@60Hz HDMI output, three USB-A 3.0 ports, an SD/microSD card reader, and 100W Power Delivery pass-through so your laptop charges while you work. Aluminium shell stays cool during extended use. Plug-and-play — no drivers needed.

name: Linen Blend Straight Kurta
shortDescription: Relaxed-fit linen-blend kurta perfect for festive and casual occasions.
description: Crafted from a premium linen-cotton blend, this kurta offers breathability and a natural texture that only gets better with each wash. The straight silhouette and subtle pintuck detailing make it equally suitable for family gatherings or everyday office wear. Machine washable. Available in sizes S to XXL.

name: Everyday Graphic Tee
shortDescription: 100% cotton boxy-fit tee with an original graphic print.
description: Made from 200 GSM ring-spun cotton, this boxy-fit tee is as comfortable at brunch as it is on lazy Sundays. Pre-shrunk fabric keeps the fit true after washing. The oversized graphic is screen-printed with water-based inks that stay vibrant wash after wash. Available in five colourways.

name: Terra Sneakers
shortDescription: Lightweight EVA-sole sneakers with memory foam insole.
description: Terra Sneakers combine a vulcanised rubber sole with an ultra-light EVA midsole to keep your feet comfortable all day. The breathable mesh upper prevents overheating and the memory foam insole molds to your foot shape. A minimalist triple-white colourway pairs with almost any outfit.

name: Cast Iron Kadai 28 cm
shortDescription: Pre-seasoned cast iron kadai compatible with all hob types including induction.
description: The IronChef cast iron kadai comes pre-seasoned with food-grade vegetable oil so it's ready to cook straight out of the box. Exceptional heat retention ensures even cooking and perfect browning. The thick base distributes heat uniformly across all hob types — gas, induction, electric, and ceramic. Builds a natural non-stick patina over time.

name: Bamboo Storage Basket Set (3 pcs)
shortDescription: Handwoven bamboo baskets in three sizes for pantry, bathroom, and desk.
description: Sustainably sourced and handcrafted, these bamboo baskets add warmth and texture to any space. The tight weave keeps contents dust-free while the open-top design makes items easy to grab. Sold as a set of three graduated sizes (S / M / L). Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Suitable for pantry, countertop, bookshelf, or bathroom use.

name: Glow Vitamin C Serum 30 ml
shortDescription: 15% Vitamin C + Hyaluronic Acid serum for brightening and hydration.
description: LuminaLab's Glow Serum combines stabilised 15% L-ascorbic acid with 2% Hyaluronic Acid and Niacinamide to visibly brighten, plump, and even skin tone in 4 weeks. Lightweight, non-greasy, and suitable for all skin types. Free from parabens, SLS, and artificial fragrance. Dermatologically tested.

name: Activated Charcoal Face Wash 100 ml
shortDescription: Deep-cleansing charcoal face wash that removes excess oil without stripping.
description: Activated charcoal micro-particles draw out impurities, excess sebum, and environmental pollutants from deep within pores without disrupting the skin's natural barrier. Enriched with Aloe Vera and Green Tea extract for a soothing post-wash feel. Suitable for oily and combination skin. Sulphate-free.

name: Adjustable Dumbbell Pair 2–20 kg
shortDescription: Dial-select dumbbells replacing a full rack of weights in seconds.
description: IronGrip's dial-select system lets you switch from 2 kg to 20 kg in 2-kg increments with a simple twist — no more fumbling with loose plates. Anti-roll base and textured chrome handle provide a secure grip. Each dumbbell replaces 10 separate weights; the included storage tray keeps your space tidy. Suitable for all major muscle groups.

name: Eco TPE Yoga Mat 6 mm
shortDescription: Non-slip, eco-friendly TPE yoga mat with alignment lines and carry strap.
description: ZenFlex's TPE mat is free from PVC, latex, and toxic dyes, making it safe for skin contact and kind to the environment. The dual-texture surface provides firm grip on hardwood and tile floors while the closed-cell foam prevents moisture absorption and bacterial growth. Alignment lines guide posture for beginners and advanced practitioners alike. Includes carry strap.
